title: Brake Operator
description:
Job Overview: A Press Brake Operator is responsible for setting up and operating press brake machines to bend, shape, and form metal sheets and plates according to specified blueprints and production requirements. This role requires expertise in machine operation, precision, and the ability to interpret technical drawings.

Responsibilities:

Machine Setup: Set up press brake machines by installing and adjusting tooling, selecting appropriate dies, and programming machine parameters based on job specifications.

Material Preparation: Load and position metal parts onto the press brake, ensuring proper alignment and secure clamping.

Machine Operation: Operate the press brake to bend or shape metal according to engineering drawings, production orders, or customer specifications.

Quality Control: Inspect finished products for accuracy, completeness, and quality, making necessary adjustments to achieve desired results.

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to machine operation, tooling, or material, ensuring smooth production processes.

Measurement and Documentation: Use precision measuring instruments to verify dimensions and record production data.

Safety Compliance: Adhere to safety guidelines and protocols, including the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and safe machine operation practices.

Collaboration: Work closely with team members, including engineers and quality control personnel, to ensure efficient production and meet quality standards.

Qualifications:

Previous experience as a Press Brake Operator or in a similar metal fabrication role.

Knowledge of press brake setup, tooling, and programming.

Ability to interpret technical drawings and blueprints.

Familiarity with precision measuring instruments.

Attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Physical stamina and ability to lift/move heavy materials.

Problem-solving skills and mechanical aptitude.

Physical Requirements: The job may involve standing for extended periods, lifting heavy materials, and performing repetitive tasks.

Work Environment: Press Brake Operators typically work in a manufacturing or metal fabrication environment, where noise levels and exposure to machinery are common. Adherence to safety protocols is essential.

title: IT Project Manager
description:
Job#: 26-01955

Location: Anchorage, Alaska
Pay: $65 - $70/HR (DOE)
Schedule: 9/80
Duration: 12-month Contract with extension likely

JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary

Alaska Digital Technologies (AKDT) is seeking a skilled IT Project Manager to play a key role in delivering high-impact IT and digital initiatives across Alaska. This position supports programs and projects spanning enterprise and local applications across petrochemical and business capabilities with a focus on value driven planning, disciplined execution, and operational readiness.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in finance, project controls, and scaled agile and traditional project management. You will partner with other project managers, business stakeholders, financial analysts, vendors, and IT delivery teams to advance strategic priorities and deliver successful outcomes. We are looking for someone who listens actively, welcomes diverse perspectives, drives results through influence, and has a genuine curiosity for learning and applying the technical side of the oil and gas business and the IT systems that support it.

Your responsibilities may include:

Project Management, Support, and Coordination

  • Develop and track project plans, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and risks
  • Prepare status reports for leadership to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery aligned to business goals; escalate risks as needed
  • Support product owner and business analysts with business case development, stakeholder alignment, budget preparation, vendor and alternatives analysis, execution, governance, risk tracking, and OCM planning throughout the SDLC
  • Support and advise on both agile and traditional project management practices as applicable, including development of related artifacts
  • Recommend appropriate project management tools and methodology (waterfall, agile, hybrid) based on project requirements
  • Serve as scrum master for facilitating events, sprint planning, and execution
  • Lead UAT administration including testing configuration, design, and execution
  • Support transition of projects to ongoing support, lead knowledge transfer, capture lessons learned, and complete close activities
Operational & Financial Support
  • Support AFE preparation (FEL & EXE phases) and other financial documentation
  • Support budget development, forecasting, monthly estimates and cost submissions, and year-end close activities for programs and projects as assigned
  • Support third-party project controls including budgeting, plan-forward activities, MSA renewals, service confirmations, and invoice tracking
  • Coordinate with third-party vendors across Alaska locations and provide light AV program coordination across Anchorage Tower, Kuparuk, Alpine, and Willow

Basic/Required

  • 5 or more years of experience in information technology
  • 2 or more years of experience in project management
  • 2 or more years of experience building and tracking project budgets
  • Basic knowledge of SAFe Agile delivery and/or PMI principles
  • PMP certification
  • SAFe Scrum Master or other scrum master certification
  • Experience with the following applications: S/4HANA, PIMS, GEP, Microsoft Project, Microsoft Visio, Jira, Microsoft Office Suite

Education:

  • (Required) Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Math, Engineering, Statistics, Information Systems, Information Science, or equivalent experience
  • (Preferred) Master's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Math, Engineering, Statistics, Information Systems, Information Science, or a related technical field (or foreign equivalent)


Benefits:

The benefits available with this position include:

  • Ongoing Training (RSO, Systems, Software Programs, OSHA Safety, JJ Keller, etc.)
  • Continuous Employment Development and Learning
  • Ongoing Advocacy, internal assets with HSE, Legal and HR teams and experts to aid in Employee Career Path and Advancement
  • 401K
  • Healthcare Group Medical Coverage & Healthcare for California only
  • Dental Insurance Coverage
  • Vision Insurance Coverage
  • Basic Life Insurance & AD&D
  • Long Term Disability
  • Voluntary Short-Term Disability
  • Direct Deposit
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts
